unknownFields: Preserved unsupported pending complete governing classification
optionsAdmission: Retain exact array carriers before interpretation. Validate original dimensions/nulls and selected per-option grammar. Unknown keys, duplicate/conflicting keys or unclassified values prevent complete interpretation rather than last-value-wins or silent dropping. NULL and empty remain raw-distinct until governing native meaning admits equivalence.
policyAdmission: Resolve shared owner/grant principals under original cluster scope; PUBLIC sentinel applies only in ACL context. Admit native tablespace ACL/default meaning and current actor CREATE rights separately. No local database address substitutes for shared role or tablespace identity.
additionalRequiredDefinitions: original database/default-placement context when reached from a relation
canonicalProducer: Resolved shared name/owner/full policy and admitted option meaning, with exact raw evidence retained. A semantic option map requires explicit duplicate/order/default interpretation; sorted raw strings are not automatically native equality. Physical location is not observed by this route and cannot be inferred from name/OID/options.
placementAdmission: Relation reltablespace zero is contextual default, never an object address; bind original database/default and object-kind placement rules separately. Same metadata across clusters does not prove same physical storage.
observationPolicy: No filesystem reads, tablespace creation/move, option updates or authority changes during collection. Missing physical-placement evidence qualifies only declared metadata, not operational equivalence.
